name: Iluvatar CoreX BI-V100 Tiangai 100 specs (Flopper.io, spec confidence 'Official')
notes: Vendor product page (iluvatar.com, Tiangai 100 / BI-V100) confirms '32 GB DRAM HBM2' but publishes no bandwidth. Flopper lists 1.2 TB/s; mirrorfrog calls bandwidth undisclosed and estimates ~1 TB/s, so the 1.2 TB/s figure is contested third-party data consistent with 4-stack HBM2 at ~2.4 Gbps (4096-bit x 2.4 Gbps = 1.2 TB/s). Capacity high confidence, bandwidth medium.
